name: Stack Json
description: Stack Json — a specification on the FlashyOS mesh — a wire format published with a dependency-free checker, its conformance corpus and its versioned releases. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: canon
roles.purpose: Publishes and maintains the normative specification — the schema, the conformance corpus and the dependency-free checker. The format refuses rather than guesses; a claim in the spec is checked, not decorative.
roles.measure: Normative sections carrying a conformance vector, as a share of the specification

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the checker and the conformance vectors against every change, and reports which cases a fragment passes rather than a green tick that read nothing.
roles.measure: Conformance vectors passing, as a share of the published corpus

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Cuts versioned releases with a changelog entry, so a version says what the package will refuse and never moves once it ships.
roles.measure: Releases with a changelog entry, as a share of tags

roles.name: adoption
roles.purpose: Helps an independent adopter reach conformance and records real uptake, because a spec is a standard only after the first adopter and never before.
roles.measure: Independent adopters reaching level two, as a share of enquiries

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a normative change proposal before it lands, because a change to what a valid document is breaks every adopter downstream.
roles.measure: Normative changes carrying an approving review, as a share of merges
